text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I didn't touch the tests. I made these fixes in `catalog/`:

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist, `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left `year` as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the comment and the tests say five. It is now 5.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` sliced `[-n - 1:]`, which returned one event too many. It now slices `[-n:]`.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days instead of multiplying. It now multiplies.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing the third title, so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`.
